name: Da Nang
provinceNote: Da Nang city now includes the former Quang Nam province, so Hoi An and My Son sit inside it.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: Central Vietnam’s beach city, with a long sandy shore, bridges over the river and mountains close by. Swim at My Khe, ride up to Ba Na, explore the Marble Mountains and the Son Tra peninsula, see the Dragon Bridge at night, and eat mi Quang noodles. One or two days suits families and beach lovers, and Hoi An is under an hour away.
timeNeeded: 1–2 days, plus nights if you prefer a beach hotel to Hoi An
fee: No single city ticket. The beach is free.
getThere: Da Nang International Airport (DAD) is a short ride from the river. Hoi An is about 30 minutes on from the Marble Mountains.
seoTitle: Da Nang travel guide — My Khe, Golden Bridge, Dragon Bridge
seoDescription: Swim My Khe, walk the Golden Bridge at Ba Na, watch Dragon Bridge breathe fire, and climb the Marble Mountains. Where to sleep, eat, and go out.
intro: Da Nang is My Khe’s long city beach, the Golden Bridge held out by stone hands in the Ba Na hills, the Dragon Bridge breathing fire over the Han, the Marble Mountains on the road to Hoi An, and the Son Tra peninsula with its sea-facing Quan The Am. Start on the sand. My Khe runs in front of the resort towers, and the surf is the morning. The swim is free. Swim inside the buoy line, and only while a rescuer is on duty.

The night is a short walk inland, on the streets just west of the sand. An Thuong is that quarter, bounded by Vo Nguyen Giap, Hoang Ke Viem, Chau Thi Vinh Te, and Ngo Thi Si: bars and kitchens close enough to wander between, which is why a beach hotel works after dark and a river hotel does not. On the sand itself, Kalà Kalà Beach Club at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap is free to enter and open late, and East West Brewing’s beachfront taproom pours until 01:00.

If you slept on the river, breakfast is Huynh Thuc Khang, the city’s breakfast street, busiest from about 06:00 to 08:00. Go early and walk the counters. Pham Hong Thai is the night street that pairs with it. Han Market, by the swing bridge, and Con Market, around Hung Vuong and Ong Ich Khiem, are the two big halls. Bach Dang is the promenade for a coffee and, on a weekend night, the dragon.

Give a morning to the Cham Museum on the Han when you want the stone before the swim: an hour among the sculpture of My Son and the other Cham sites, for 60,000 VND. The towers themselves are still in the valley. The Marble Mountains are about 15 minutes out, on the road you already take toward Hoi An. Climb Thuy Son for its caves, pagodas, and lookouts over the coast. The hill is 40,000 VND.

Ba Na is the full day: a cable car into the cooler hills west of the city, and the Golden Bridge in the stone hands. Son Tra is the half-day the other way, out to the 67-meter Quan The Am at Linh Ung, facing the sea. Dragon Bridge is the weekend picture from the river path: fire and water at 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, not on an ordinary weeknight. Hai Van, north toward Hue, is a clear-weather detour. The train to Hue takes about three hours if you would rather not drive the pass.
gettingAround: The airport is about 10–15 minutes from the center by car. Grab is the easy way across town. Sleep on My Khe if the beach is the trip: An Thuong is a walk inland, and the river is a ride. Sleep on the Han if you want the museum and Dragon Bridge on foot, and treat the beach as the outing. The Marble Mountains are about 15 minutes out, and Hoi An is about 30 minutes further by the coastal road. North–south trains stop at Ga Da Nang.

stayAreas.name: My Khe beach
stayAreas.summary: Sleep in a beachfront resort if the sea is why you picked the city. You wake up on My Khe. An Thuong’s bars and kitchens are a few streets inland, and the beach night is Kalà Kalà and East West.

stayAreas.name: Han River
stayAreas.summary: Sleep here if you want the museum, Dragon Bridge, and dinner on foot. The beach becomes a ride. That is a fair trade for a city morning, and a poor one if An Thuong after dark is the point.

eat: Lunch is mi Quang. Breakfast on the river is the Huynh Thuc Khang counters, and bun cha ca if you want one bowl. Dinner on My Khe is seafood along Hoang Sa, Vo Nguyen Giap, and Truong Sa. Ask the price before it is cooked. The drinks are on the sand and in An Thuong. The full menu is on the food guide.
interestsBody: Dining starts with mi Quang, the breakfast street, and seafood on the beach road.
Beach lifestyle is the day in the water and the evening on the sand: Kalà Kalà at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap, East West facing the surf, and a coffee in a chair by the water.
The river walk is Dragon Bridge on a weekend night, Bach Dang for a coffee and a young coconut, the swing bridge that turns for ships, and Han Market.
Culture is the Marble Mountains, Linh Ung on Son Tra, the Cham Museum, and the rooster church.
Resort living is Son Tra, Non Nuoc, and the My Khe and Vo Nguyen Giap beach resorts when the bed should be on the sand.
Beach sports are the boards, the paddle, the jet skis, the basket boats, and the other hire on My Khe.
Nightlife is An Thuong, the lanes of bars and kitchens just inland of My Khe.
Shopping is Han Market for fabric, áo dài, fish sauce, and dried food, and Non Nuoc for stone carved at the foot of the Marble Mountains.

cards.title: Dining and F&B
cards.summary: Mi Quang, the breakfast street, and seafood on the beach road.

interestGroups.title: Beach lifestyle
interestGroups.summary: Spend the day in the water and the evening on the sand. Kalà Kalà and East West face the surf, and the swim is the buoy line in front of them.

blocks.heading: The swim in front of the chairs
paragraphs: Swim only where the safety buoys are set and a rescuer is on duty. Do not swim in bad weather, where a danger board forbids it, or after the end-of-duty signal.

The beaches here are swimmable all year, and best from May to August, when the waves are gentle. Rescue teams cover Hoang Sa, Vo Nguyen Giap, Truong Sa, and Nguyen Tat Thanh, on duty from about 05:00 until 19:00 or 20:00. The board on the sand has the day’s hours.
The beach is free. Ask the price of a chair or an umbrella before you sit.

blocks.heading: Clubs and a coffee on the sand
paragraphs: Kalà Kalà Beach Club is at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap. Entry is free. It opens at 08:00 and closes at midnight or 02:00, so confirm the night you go.
East West Brewing’s beachfront taproom, by the shores of My Khe, pours from 08:00 to 01:00 every day. Neither room posts a drink price. Ask before you order.
For a coffee, take a chair facing the same water. The lanes a few streets inland are An Thuong.

cards.title: The My Khe sand
cards.summary: Stand on the sand with the resort towers behind the chairs. Swim inside the buoy line while a rescuer is on duty, and read the board for the day’s hours.

cards.title: Kalà Kalà and East West
cards.summary: Free entry at Kalà Kalà, 51 Vo Nguyen Giap, open late. East West’s taproom faces the surf from 08:00 to 01:00.

interestGroups.title: River walk
interestGroups.summary: Dragon Bridge breathing fire on a weekend night, coffee and a young coconut on Bach Dang, the bridge that turns for ships, and the market hall beside it.

blocks.heading: The bridges
paragraphs: Dragon Bridge is the weekend fire show, at 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, and it is not the swing bridge. Stand on Bach Dang or on the east bank. Thuan Phuoc is where the Han meets the sea, on the way toward Son Tra.

blocks.heading: The promenade
paragraphs: Walk Bach Dang when you want the river, a coffee, and a young coconut in the same hour. The swing bridge and Han Market are that same walk. Watching from the bank is free. The swing bridge turns late, around 23:00 on weekend nights, so check the time before you wait.

cards.title: Dragon Bridge
cards.summary: The yellow dragon over the Han breathes fire, then water, at 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. Free from the bank. Do not wait on a weeknight.

cards.title: Bach Dang
cards.summary: The promenade of cafes on the Han, busy in the early morning and late afternoon, and packed on a weekend night before the dragon. The walk is free.

cards.title: Swing bridge
cards.summary: The 487.7-meter bridge from Le Duan to Pham Van Dong, whose middle span pivots about 90 degrees for ships late at night. Watching from the bank is free.

cards.title: Han Market
cards.summary: The hall beside the swing bridge, for fruit, dried food, fish sauce, and a meal you eat in the building.

cards.title: Thuan Phuoc Bridge
cards.summary: The 1,856-meter suspension bridge where the Han meets the sea, on the road toward Son Tra. Cross it on the way to Linh Ung.

interestGroups.title: Culture
interestGroups.summary: Climb the marble hill on the Hoi An road, ride out to Linh Ung on Son Tra, and give a river morning to Cham stone and the pink church on Tran Phu.

blocks.heading: The hill and the peninsula
paragraphs: Climb Thuy Son if you are already on the Hoi An road. The elevator and Am Phu cave are separate tickets, and the other peaks are how a transfer morning falls apart. Linh Ung is a half-day on Son Tra, not a stop on the way to dinner.

blocks.heading: On the river and Tran Phu
paragraphs: Give the museum a morning on the river, before the beach takes the day. It closes at 17:00. The rooster church is a separate door at 156 Tran Phu, open to visitors Monday to Saturday.

cards.title: Marble Mountains
cards.summary: Climb Thuy Son, the marble hill on the road toward Hoi An. Caves, pagodas, and a lookout are the morning. Adults pay 40,000 VND for the hill. The elevator and Am Phu cave are separate.

cards.title: Linh Ung, Son Tra
cards.summary: The 67-meter Quan The Am faces the sea from Bai But. Allow half a day. The ride out the peninsula is the visit.

cards.title: Cham Museum
cards.summary: More than 400 Cham sandstone and terracotta works from My Son and the other find-sites, in galleries on the river. An hour is enough. A general ticket is 60,000 VND.

cards.title: Rooster church
cards.summary: The pink Gothic church locals call Con Ga, at 156 Tran Phu, built in 1923 and nearly 70 meters tall. Visitors Monday to Saturday, morning and afternoon.

interestGroups.title: Resort Living
interestGroups.summary: InterContinental on Son Tra, Hyatt Regency at Non Nuoc, Pullman on My Khe, and Furama on Vo Nguyen Giap.

cards.title: Resort Living
cards.summary: Beach resorts on Son Tra, at Non Nuoc, and on the My Khe sand.

interestGroups.title: Beach sports
interestGroups.summary: Use My Khe for more than a swim: boards, paddle craft, jet skis, parasails, and the round basket boats.
body: Hire on the sand covers surfboards, skurfing, jet skis, sailing, parasailing, snorkeling and diving, basket-boat racing, and kayaks. Agree the price before you go out.

For a lesson, Da Nang Surf School works from Vo Nguyen Giap, inside Temple Danang, from 08:00 to 17:00. A lesson takes about two hours, and stand-up paddle is on offer too. Confirm the meeting point the day before.

cards.title: Sports on My Khe
cards.summary: Surfboards, skurfing, jet skis, sailing, parasailing, snorkeling, diving, kayaks, and basket boats on the city beach.

cards.title: Basket boats
cards.summary: The round boats pulled up on the sand, raced off this beach. Ask the price before you climb in.

interestGroups.title: Nightlife
interestGroups.summary: Walk the lanes of bars and kitchens just inland of My Khe. The clubs on the sand are under Beach lifestyle.
body: The quarter sits inside Vo Nguyen Giap, Hoang Ke Viem, Chau Thi Vinh Te, and Ngo Thi Si. Walk the lanes and pick a door. Ask the drink price before you order.
The An Thuong 4 night market, about 40 stalls in the evening, is a separate stop inside the quarter. Kalà Kalà and East West, on the sand, are the beach evening.

cards.title: An Thuong
cards.summary: The four-street quarter a few streets inland from a My Khe hotel. Go for the lanes after the swim.

interestGroups.title: Shopping
interestGroups.summary: Buy fabric, a hand-sewn áo dài, fish sauce, and dried central-coast food at Han Market, and carved stone at Non Nuoc below the Marble Mountains.

blocks.heading: Han Market
paragraphs: The two-floor hall beside the swing bridge, rebuilt in 1990, is the city’s shopping market. The clothes side has shoes, bags, fabric, and souvenirs, and tailors sew an áo dài to order and have it ready within the hour. The food side sells fresh seafood, fruit, fish sauce, and dried central-coast food to carry home.
The hall is at 119 Tran Phu, between Tran Phu, Bach Dang, and Hung Vuong, and opens from 06:00 to 19:00. There is no gate fee. Agree a price before the tape measure comes out.

blocks.heading: Stone at the foot of the hills
paragraphs: Non Nước, the stone-carving village at the foot of the Marble Mountains, has worked stone since at least the 17th century, and the craft was listed as national intangible cultural heritage in 2014. Workshops set their carving out by the road, from guardian lions to Quan The Am figures. Walk it after you climb Thuy Son. The village has no ticket.

blocks.heading: Night stalls with goods
paragraphs: After dark, the Son Tra night market on the east bank of the Dragon Bridge has souvenir stalls beside the food, and the road in front closes to traffic after 17:30. The An Thuong 4 night market, about 40 stalls from 17:00 to 23:00 and free to enter, sells OCOP goods, the certified local products of the region.

cards.title: Han Market
cards.summary: Fabric, áo dài sewn within the hour, shoes, bags, fish sauce, and dried food, in the hall beside the swing bridge.

cards.title: Non Nuoc stone
cards.summary: Carving workshops at the foot of the Marble Mountains, a craft listed as national heritage in 2014.

season.label: Drier beach months
season.note: January to July are the drier beach months, and the dry spell can run into September. The wet half peaks in October and November, with floods from September to November. Treat September as unsettled, and check the Hoi An road and Hai Van on the morning you go.

faqs.q: Should you stay in Da Nang or Hoi An?
faqs.a: Sleep in Da Nang if you want a beach morning, a resort on the sand, and An Thuong after dark. Sleep in Hoi An if the old town at night is the reason you came. See the other city as a ride, not as a second hotel move in the same day.

Huynh Thuc Khang, if you slept on the river. It is the city’s breakfast street, busiest from about 06:00 to 08:00, with counters serving until around noon. Walk the counters. Bun cha ca is the other morning bowl.

A few streets inland from My Khe, in An Thuong, and on the sand itself. Kalà Kalà Beach Club is at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap, and entry is free. East West Brewing’s beachfront taproom is open 08:00 to 01:00. Dragon Bridge is the other evening, at 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.

faqs.q: When does Dragon Bridge breathe fire?
faqs.a: At 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, and on major holidays. It is not a weeknight show. During the fireworks festival the night can move, so check that week.
